faq.compatibleQ: Will it work on my phone?
faq.compatibleA: Your phone must support eSIM and be carrier-unlocked. Most iPhones since the XS, Google Pixel 3 and later, and recent Samsung Galaxy models do.
faq.whenA: Install it before you leave, while you have Wi-Fi. The plan starts when it first connects at your destination, unless the plan says otherwise.
faq.numberQ: Do I keep my phone number?
faq.numberA: Yes. The eSIM is for data; your usual SIM stays in the phone for calls and texts.
faq.topupA: Plans marked "Top up this plan" or "Add more packages" can be topped up from My eSIMs.

esim.pricingHint: Selling price = cost × exchange rate × (1 + buffer) × (1 + markup), never below the minimum margin, rounded up. The most specific enabled rule sets the markup.
esim.minMarginHint: Of the selling price; protects against a low markup.
esim.fxBufferHint: Added to the converted cost against rate swings.
esim.threshold: Re-price when a rate moves more than %
esim.noRules: No rules: every plan uses the default markup.
esim.fxHint: European Central Bank rates, refreshed daily; latest {date}. A manual rate wins until removed.
esim.ruleHint: Leave a field on "any" to match everything. A rule naming more fields wins; between equals, the higher priority.
esim.syncStarted: Sync started. It can take a few minutes; refresh to see progress.
esim.providerPriority: Priority (lower is preferred when prices tie)
esim.providersHint: The eSIM suppliers plans are bought from. A supplier that is off is neither synced nor sold.
